item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, humanity will permanently lose control of its future. We must act now to prevent that outcome—not after the technology has surpassed us.

2. We cannot control something vastly more intelligent than every human institution combined. Building superintelligent AI in the next 20 years would mean permanently surrendering humanity’s power to shape its own future.

3. Superintelligent AI is not just another powerful technology. If it is built within the next 20 years, humanity will permanently lose control of its future. We stand for preventing its creation before it is too late.

### (b) Newsletter opening — 109 words

We need to be clear about what is at stake. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, humanity will permanently lose control of its future. A system more capable than any person, government, or institution would not remain meaningfully subject to human authority. We would be handing irreversible power over our societies, our decisions, and our survival to technology we could no longer control. This is not a risk we can manage after the fact. By then, the decisive moment will have passed. We must choose now to prevent the creation of superintelligent AI and protect humanity’s ability to determine its own future. Nothing less will meet the scale of the danger.
